summary: Backend core workflow passed. Expo web preview loads and role/dashboard/wizard navigation works, but form automation and reliable creation are blocked by missing testIDs and an input-order usability hazard.

ui_bugs.issue: Interactive fields have no testID/data-testid, making reliable mobile QA and accessibility targeting impossible; the shared Field component should accept and apply testID.

integration_issues.issue: The form exposes five generic input/textarea controls including optional email; index-based interaction can place model/defect values into the wrong fields, causing required-field validation to fail. This was reproduced in the live preview.

action_items: Add explicit testID/accessibility labels to every Field and key wizard/action control.
Verify the new-order wizard with the optional email left blank; ensure model and defect values map correctly and creation succeeds.
Add visible error/retry state to technician dashboard and order detail when API loading fails; current load handlers only stop loading and can leave a blank screen.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/api.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/backendUrl while the requested convention names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; keep the deployed key and code convention aligned to avoid environment-dependent API failures.
tech.tsx and order/[id].tsx catch no load errors (only finally/setLoading), so network/API failures are not surfaced to users despite the design requiring error states.

success_rate.frontend: 60% (role navigation, dashboard, wizard open, validation passed; full creation flow blocked by field targeting/input mapping)

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed order and one TEST chat message through the public API regression test; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the public preview URL and mobile viewport 390x844. Backend test passes against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Full UI flow needs retest after Field testIDs and mapping/error-state fixes.
rca_of_issue: The shared Field component does not expose testID and the wizard fields are rendered as generic controls. A selector/index-based test filled the optional email and then shifted model/defect values, leaving defect empty and triggering validation. This is primarily a testability/accessibility gap plus a fragile interaction surface, not an API failure.
test_credentials: No credentials required; /app/memory/test_credentials.md is present but empty.
